name: backseat-ai
description: Guarded agent workflows: an XState machine an agent drives one enabled move at a time, and a CLI that fronts it.

scripts.prepack: node -e "for (const p of ['dist', 'docs']) fs.rmSync(p, { recursive: true, force: true }); fs.cpSync('../../docs', 'docs', { recursive: true, filter: (s) => !['captures', 'agents'].includes(path.relative('../../docs', s)) }); fs.copyFileSync('../../GLOSSARY.md', 'GLOSSARY.md')" && tsc -b --force
